concerns.text: FR-001 (Download at least 30,000 entries) is not covered. Task T024 downloads 'at least 150,000 entries', which satisfies the volume but fails to explicitly tag or reference FR-001. The spec requires a minimum of 30k, but the task description does not link to the requirement ID, making traceability incomplete for the 'Download' requirement specifically.

FR-002 (Filter entries for valid formation_energy and dft_computed=True) lacks a direct task tag. Task T025 implements this logic but is only tagged with [US1]. Without a [FR-002] tag or explicit mention in the description, the requirement is not formally covered in the task list.

FR-003 (Generate elemental property descriptors) is not explicitly tagged. Task T026 implements descriptor generation but only carries the [US1] tag. The requirement ID is missing from the task metadata.

FR-004 (Impute missing values using training pool statistics) is not tagged. Task T027 implements this but lacks the [FR-004] tag, breaking the traceability chain for this specific functional requirement.
FR-005 (Cap training pool at RSS_SIZE) is not tagged. Task T031 implements the RSS capping but is only tagged with [US2]. The requirement ID is missing.

FR-005 (Train GPR and RF models) is not tagged. Task T035 implements model training but lacks the [FR-005] tag. Note: FR-005 appears in both US-1 and US-2 in the spec; the task for US-2 implementation is missing the tag.
FR-006 (Evaluate models using RMSE, MAE, Predictive Variance, Calibration Slope) is not tagged. Task T037 implements evaluation but lacks the [FR-006] tag.
FR-008 (Generate final report as associational evidence) is not tagged. Task T048 generates the report but lacks the [FR-008] tag.
SC-001 (Measure RMSE, MAE, Predictive Variance, Calibration Slope) is not tagged. Task T037 and T038 cover this but lack the [SC-001] tag.
SC-002 (Generate learning curves) is not tagged. Task T042 implements this but lacks the [SC-002] tag.
SC-003 (Apply pairwise contrasts with Tukey-adjusted p-values) is not tagged. Task T044 implements this but lacks the [SC-003] tag.

Task T060b is marked [X] (completed) but references updating 'spec.md FR-005'. The spec.md provided in the input already lists FR-005 as 'Model Evaluation Metrics' (RMSE, MAE, etc.) and does not explicitly mention 'Calibration Slope' in the FR text itself, though it is in the US-3 section. The task claims to 'close scope creep' by mandating it in FR-005, but the spec text provided does not reflect this update yet, creating a stale tag/implementation mismatch.
